definitions.short: to store away , i.e. (figuratively) in the memory
definitions.full: H3647. kamas [ כָּמַס ] verb store up (si vera 1.), in Qal Passive participle כָּמֻס Deut 32:34 is not this stored up ( laid up in store ) with me (|| בְּאוֺצְרֹתָ֑י חָתוּם ); but read probably כָנֻס in same. meaning (see כנס , and Dr 32:34 ).
